title: truth-order-closure
description: The truth-order closure operator T_t: the parallel construction to the standard knowledge-order closure that is monotone in the truth order ≤_t, each step adding truthfulness (cells move from f toward ⊥ or ⊤ to t) rather than information. Generated within settling as the cross-order dual of T_k under the order-swap involution σ.

operator.description: an endofunctor on predication-presheaves, v |-> T_t(v)

order.description: monotone in the truth order ≤_t (f ≤_t ⊥, ⊤ ≤_t t), orthogonal to the knowledge order driving T_k

monotonicity.description: ≤_t-monotonicity: if v ≤_t v' pointwise then T_t(v) ≤_t T_t(v')

lax-idempotence.description: KZ 2-cells δ : T_t · T_t ⇒ T_t realize the lax-idempotent closure 2-monad structure

closure-ordinal.description: κ^t := min{τ : T_t^τ(v_0) = T_t^(τ+1)(v_0)}; the truth-order fixed point v_κ^t; subject to the four-regime dichotomy, distinct from kappa^k

order-swap-involution.description: σ : FOUR -> FOUR swapping ⊥ <-> f, t <-> ⊤, exchanging the two lattice structures so every T_k theorem has a σ-conjugate T_t theorem
